HEADLINE: Please note that the Board of Directors of the Company, at its meeting held on Friday, November 13, 2026, has, inter alia, considered and approved the Unaudited Standalone Financial Results ....
MORE:
Please note that the Board of Directors of the Company, at its meeting held on Friday, November 13, 2026, has, inter alia, considered and approved the Unaudited Standalone Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.

Pursuant to Regulation 30, 33 and other applicable provisions of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 read with Schedule III thereto, please find enclosed the Unaudited Standalone Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, approved by the Board of Directors along with the Limited Review Report thereon issued by the Statutory Auditors of the Company.

The Board Meeting commenced at 6:30 P.M. and concluded at 7:00 P.M.

MORE:
Olympic Oil Industries Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 13/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve the Un-Audited Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026.

Further, as informed earlier vide our letter dated 28th September, 2026 the trading window shall continue to remain closed till 48 hours after communication of aforesaid Financial Results to the Stock Exchange.
